en_us.title: Modpack Update Available
message: A new modpack version is available.
Current version: {current_version}
Latest version: {latest_version}
Update highlights:
New Content:
[+] Added a race route evolution tree, allowing players to view the full evolution paths and race stats directly in the race screen.

[+] Added the “Adventure Archive”, which records the skills and some items obtained by the player. Each skill and item includes usage instructions as an Offline Wiki, and clicking a skill page can jump directly to the corresponding archive entry.
[+] Added the Ultimate Skill “Storm King Veldora”.
[+] Subordinates are now stronger and can actively use skills.
[+] The Orc race now has its own model.
[+] When selecting a race for the first time, a “World Settings” button will appear in the top-right corner, allowing some rules to be adjusted directly.
[+] Added a new dimension, “The Forgotten Chronology”, along with Boss challenges.
[+] Added ancient dwarven underground ruins.
[+] Added new quest chapters and adjusted some quest descriptions.
[+] Added a new Boss: Mecha Catgirl.
[+] Evolvable equipment now displays its evolution target and required EP in its description.
Adjustments & Optimizations:
[+] Adjusted quest book rewards and added Soul Energy reward entries.
Fixes:
[+] Fixed the issue where the Lobotomized race would remain in the Dream Dimension after being killed there.
[+] Fixed an issue where closing the Online Wiki could make it impossible to exit the web module.
Please download the modpack from the official website or Quark Drive.

zh_cn.title: 发现整合包新版本
message: 检测到整合包有新版本。
当前版本：{current_version}
最新版本：{latest_version}
更新内容：
新增内容：
[+] 增加种族路线进化树形图，玩家可在种族界面中直接查看完整的进化方向与种族数值。
[+] 增加“冒险档案”，记录玩家获取的技能与部分物品，并为每个技能与物品说明使用方法（离线Wiki）；在对应技能页点击也能直接跳转到对应档案。
[+] 增加究极技能“暴风之王维鲁德拉”。
[+] 下属更加强大，并能主动使用技能。
[+] 猪头族现在拥有自己的建模。
[+] 首次选择种族时，右上角会出现“世界设定”按钮，可直接调整部分规则。
[+] 添加新维度《被遗忘的时序》与Boss挑战。
[+] 添加远古时期的矮人地下废墟。
[+] 任务书新增部分章节任务，并调整部分任务描述。
[+] 增加新Boss机甲猫女。
[+] 现在，可进化装备会在描述中显示进化目标与所需EP。
调整与优化：
[+] 调整任务书奖励，新增灵魂能量奖励项。
修复内容：
[+] 修复废人种族在梦境中被击杀后仍留在梦境的问题。
[+] 修复关闭联网Wiki后可能无法退出web模块的问题。
请到官网或者夸克网盘下载整合包。
